decisions.go-api-contracts: Selected: exported operations, error identities, exact JSON file bytes, existing positional CLI grammar, and process streams/status are supported consumer contracts.
decisions.go-behavior-tests: Selected: implementation changes meaningful batch, publication, and lifecycle behavior and explicitly requests high-quality regression tests. Read the referenced observations for failure-stage, error-combination, and independent-oracle cases.
decisions.go-core-style: Selected: writing and testing standard-library Go code while retaining Go1.22 APIs and existing signatures.
decisions.go-interfaces-and-composition: Selected: supplied client/context ownership and refresh/release lifecycle change. Existing concrete clients and callback functions suffice; no new interface or options layer is needed.
decisions.go-package-boundaries: Skipped without opening: responsibilities and package/import ownership already exist in the supplied stubs; no package creation, split, merge, relocation, or import-direction change is needed.
decisions.go-test-isolation: Selected: temporary files, local HTTP, subprocesses, process-local limits, cancellation, goroutines, recurrence timing, and independent instances require explicit ownership and bounded cleanup. Read the referenced isolation patterns.
